# Security policy

Report suspected Prompt Context Builder vulnerabilities privately through GitHub Security
Advisories. Do not use a public issue. Include the affected package or source version, redacted
reproduction steps, impact, and any suggested mitigation.

Treat unexpected access to a prompt, customer value, inaccessible field or record, generated SOQL,
bind value, or diagnostic detail as a security issue.

Do not include Salesforce access tokens, session IDs, full Org IDs, customer record data, generated
prompts, or logs containing sensitive values in the report.
